import sys
import math

class GeometryUtils:
    epsilon = 1e-8
    @staticmethod
    def fastHypot(x, y):
        return math.hypot(x, y)

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if not isinstance(other, Point):
            return False
        return (abs(self.x - other.x) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon and
                abs(self.y - other.y) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon)
    def __hash__(self):
        # Not used in the algorithm, but for completeness
        return hash((self.x, self.y))
    def distance(self, other):
        return GeometryUtils.fastHypot(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"({self.x}, {self.y})"

class Line:
    def __init__(self, a, b, c):
        h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b)
        self.a = a / h
        self.b = b / h
        self.c = c / h
    @staticmethod
    def from_point_angle(p, angle):
        a = math.sin(angle)
        b = -math.cos(angle)
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b
        return Line(a, b, c)
    def intersect(self, other):
        if self.parallel(other):
            return None
        det = self.b * other.a - self.a * other.b
        x = (self.c * other.b - self.b * other.c) / det
        y = (self.a * other.c - self.c * other.a) / det
        return Point(x, y)
    def parallel(self, other):
        return abs(self.a * other.b - self.b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon
    def perpendicular(self, point):
        return Line(-self.b, self.a, self.b * point.x - self.a * point.y)
    def value(self, point):
        return self.a * point.x + self.b * point.y + self.c
    def distance(self, point):
        return abs(self.value(point))
    def intersect_circle(self, circle):
        dist = self.distance(circle.center)
        if dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return []
        inter = self.intersect(self.perpendicular(circle.center))
        if abs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return [inter]
        shift = math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist)
        return [Point(inter.x + shift * self.b, inter.y - shift * self.a),
                Point(inter.x - shift * self.b, inter.y + shift * self.a)]
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if not isinstance(other, Line):
            return False
        if not self.parallel(other):
            return False
        return (abs(self.a * other.c - other.a * self.c) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon and
                abs(self.b * other.c - other.b * self.c) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon)

class Circle:
    def __init__(self, center, radius):
        self.center = center
        self.radius = radius
    def intersect(self, other):
        dist = self.center.distance(other.center)
        if dist < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return None
        a = 2 * (other.center.x - self.center.x)
        b = 2 * (other.center.y - self.center.y)
        c = (other.radius * other.radius - self.radius * self.radius +
             self.center.x * self.center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
             self.center.y * self.center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y)
        line = Line(a, b, c)
        return line.intersect_circle(self)

class UnionFind:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.rank = [0] * n
        self.setCount = n
    def find(self, x):
        while self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.parent[self.parent[x]]
            x = self.parent[x]
        return x
    def union(self, x, y):
        xr = self.find(x)
        yr = self.find(y)
        if xr == yr:
            return False
        if self.rank[xr] < self.rank[yr]:
            xr, yr = yr, xr
        elif self.rank[xr] == self.rank[yr]:
            self.rank[xr] += 1
        self.parent[yr] = xr
        self.setCount -= 1
        return True
    def getSetCount(self):
        return self.setCount

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    x = [0]*n
    y = [0]*n
    r = [0]*n
    for i in range(n):
        x[i] = next(it)
        y[i] = next(it)
        r[i] = next(it)
    circles = [Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]) for i in range(n)]
    points = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i):
            inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j])
            if inter is not None:
                points.extend(inter)
    bad = [False]*len(points)
    for i in range(len(points)):
        for j in range(i):
            if points[i] == points[j]:
                bad[i] = True
                break
    nVertices = sum(1 for b in bad if not b)
    uf = UnionFind(len(points))
    nEdges = 0
    for i in range(n):
        onThis = []
        for j in range(len(points)):
            if not bad[j] and abs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - circles[i].radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
                onThis.append(j)
        current = len(onThis)
        for j in range(1, current):
            uf.union(onThis[j], onThis[0])
        nEdges += max(current, 1)
    nComponents = uf.getSetCount()
    for b in bad:
        if b:
            nComponents -= 1
    result = 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
